datasheet_identity.title: SS52B THRU SS520B SURFACE MOUNT SCHOTTKY BARRIER RECTIFIER (SMB Surface Mount Schottky Barrier Rectifier)

extraction_notes: Family datasheet SS52B-SS520B; SS520B is the 200 V member: VRRM = VDC = 200 V and VRMS = 140 V (p. 1). IF(AV) = 5.0 A and IFSM = 120 A at 8.3 ms half-sine are common ratings.

Table merged cells assign VF maximum 0.95 V at IF = 5.0 A to SS515B-SS520B; IR1 maximum 0.05 mA at VR = VDC, Ta = 25 degC to SS58B-SS520B; CJ typical 300 pF at 4.0 V DC and 1 MHz to the family (p. 2).
Fig.3 SS515B-SS520B forward trace was digitized from the printed linear-voltage/log-current grid; plotted current values were converted from amperes as printed and retained as SI amperes.
Fig.1 and Fig.2 are thermal/surge rating curves and were not digitized. Fig.4 is a normalized reverse-characteristics plot for grouped parts and was not used as an absolute-voltage curve.
No reverse recovery time or measured avalanche/breakdown row is published. VRRM is an absolute maximum rating, not a measured breakdown voltage, so breakdown fields are null.
